problems: The hero's roll (k.turn y = -8) lifts the right side of the brim into an exaggerated point and drops the left side, which cancels its curl. The brim reads as lopsided: curled on one side and flat or drooping on the other, not a cowboy brim curled up evenly on both sides. Remove the roll and make the side curl a little stronger so both sides visibly turn up.

The crown top reads as a round dimple with a dot artifact at the center and a lump at the back, not a front-to-back crease: the lathe profile has only four points across the top, so the warp is too coarse.
The crown sides show visible steps from the sparse profile, which the restyle may keep as bumps in the felt.
